title: Tacit Coordination of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Large Language Models on tacit coordination games (e.g., Amsterdam and Nottingham datasets) to compare their zero-shot focal point selection against human responses, and utilizing culture-oriented prompting to measure alignment with location-specific human cultural norms and archetypes.

Analyzing model responses in multiple-choice coordination tasks across multiple random permutations of option ordering to identify the models' systemic tendency to select the first available option when cultural or contextual salience is misaligned.
